message:
feat: extract read and write logic from FilesystemCommitStore

WHY
The FilesystemCommitStore previously mixed locking logic with file I/O operations, making it difficult to reuse the read logic elsewhere and preventing atomic reconciliation of the store state.

WHAT
* Extracted readLocked and write functions to separate locking concerns from I/O operations.
* Implemented Reconcile to atomically sync the store file with git log entries using the new helper functions.
* Added entriesEqual to skip unnecessary writes when the store state matches the git log exactly.
